classResults.rootCause: Diagnostic path detection depends on a limited key allowlist and preceding-character heuristic, so paths after colons, quotes or brackets and paths nested under arbitrary cause/message fields can reach logger or structured error output.

Diagnostic byte-array removal depends on binary-looking keys, Buffer-shaped nested data and arbitrary-key number arrays can survive, and the public-success projection leaves unproved one-to-three-byte fragments.
Free-string removal allowlists three image subtypes and signatures, leaving GIF, SVG or custom image data URLs, parameterized data-URL markers and unknown-header long Base64.
